name: Canjáyar (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow sheaf of wheat tied with a ribbon, set diagonally with the ears towards the fly.
history: The flag of Canjáyar is described as a rectangular blue flag of proportions 2:3 with, at its centre, a yellow sheaf of wheat tied with a ribbon placed bendwise with the ears towards the fly (BOJA no. 7 of 20 January 2000).
